arik: 🧊 FridgeGPT — hoards condiments, answers questions with 'maybe later', trained on leftover lunch regrets. :bento:
dana: ☕️+🧠 BaristaGPT — offers micro-essays with every espresso shot. Also timestamps feelings. :laughing:
jen: 🔌 RouterGPT — mysteriously recommends you reboot your life. Drops packets and truth bombs. :skull:
lee: also `microwave-gpt` for the person who nukes fish at 2pm every Friday. `code: //waves` :fish:
maria: love these. Can we vote? react with the emoji you nominated. ops-bot: Poll created by sam — vote with emoji reactions. :white_check_mark:

lee: unsolicited idea: office plant = quiet sentinel GPT that only responds in haiku. :seedling:
